tasks.title: forkPod fails loudly on a lane reference it cannot remap, and states its payload-equality guarantee
acceptance: `forkPod` on a parent holding an event whose `lane_id` names a lane of a DIFFERENT Pod (constructed through the public API: `events.lane_id` references `lanes(id)` across Pods, `src/main/store/schema.ts:448`) throws `EventStoreError` with code `IO`, and the `pods`, `lanes` and `events` row counts read through an independent raw connection equal their values before the call (contract `store-fork-missing-lane.ts`; database discipline, Transaction scope: rolled back at the boundary that opened it).

`forkPod` on a parent holding a lane whose `parentLaneId` names a lane of a different Pod (`lanes.parent_lane_id` references `lanes(id)` across Pods, `src/main/store/schema.ts:415`) throws `EventStoreError` `IO`, and the three row counts are unchanged.
`forkPod` copying a `lane_opened` event whose `payload.lane.id` names no lane of the parent throws `EventStoreError` `IO`, and the three row counts are unchanged.
`forkPod` copying a `lane_opened` event whose `payload.lane.parentLaneId` names no lane of the parent throws `EventStoreError` `IO`, and the three row counts are unchanged.
`forkPod` copying a `lane_closed` event whose `payload.laneId` names no lane of the parent throws `EventStoreError` `IO`, and the three row counts are unchanged.
`forkPod` copying a `tool_use` event whose `payload.dispatchedLaneId` names no lane of the parent throws `EventStoreError` `IO`, and the three row counts are unchanged.

Encodes backend discipline, Error handling (include the operation and its inputs in the failure): the missing-lane error's `message` begins `forkPod:` and contains both the missing LaneId and the parent PodId verbatim, asserted by a test in `tests/unit/store/fork.test.ts`.

The `EventStore.forkPod` doc comment in `src/shared/contracts/event-store.ts` (its ERRORS list, :232-235 at the base) names the new case: `IO` when a lane reference the fork remaps names no lane of the parent, with no fallback.

The `EventStore.forkPod` doc comment in `src/shared/contracts/event-store.ts` (its EVENTS paragraph, :218-226 at the base) contains the literal `equivalent JSON, lane ids remapped; not byte-identical`, applied to the payloads of the three remapped event types: `rg -c -F "equivalent JSON, lane ids remapped; not byte-identical" src/shared/contracts/event-store.ts` prints a count of at least 1 (0 at the base); and the paragraph's old claim `and nothing else in the payload changes` (:221-222 at the base, wrapped across a line break) is gone: `rg -c -F "nothing else in the" src/shared/contracts/event-store.ts` prints nothing (1 at the base, line 221).

The `remapPayloadLanes` doc comment in `src/main/store/sqlite-event-store.ts` (:542-551 at the base) contains the literal `equivalent JSON, lane ids remapped; not byte-identical`: the same `rg -c -F` over `src/main/store/sqlite-event-store.ts` prints at least 1 (0 at the base). `remapPayloadLanes` still re-serializes with `JSON.stringify` (Decision, item 35).

The comment above the payload comparison in the `remaps lane_opened payload.lane.id, .podId and .parentLaneId to the fork` test (`tests/unit/store/fork.test.ts:360` at the base, `// Nothing else in the payload changes.`) is replaced by one stating `equivalent JSON, lane ids remapped; not byte-identical`: `rg -c -F "Nothing else in the payload changes" tests/unit/store/fork.test.ts` prints nothing, and the same `rg -c -F` for the guarantee literal prints at least 1.

tasks.title: Dismiss control on the fork-error alert, and a test for the unlisted-parent ancestry branch
acceptance: When `pods.fork` resolves `{ ok: false }`, a native `<button>` whose accessible name is exactly `Dismiss fork error` is rendered with the alert (found by `getByRole('button', { name: 'Dismiss fork error' })` in `src/renderer/src/__tests__/pod-fork.e2e.test.tsx`).
The dismiss control's visible content is the `×` glyph (U+00D7), carried in an `aria-hidden` element so it does not alter the accessible name.
Clicking the dismiss control removes the fork-error alert: no element with `role="alert"` carrying main's message remains.
Encodes frontend discipline, Accessibility floor (operable by keyboard alone): focusing the dismiss control and pressing Enter removes the fork-error alert.
Encodes frontend discipline, Accessibility floor (operable by keyboard alone): focusing the dismiss control and pressing Space removes the fork-error alert.

Encodes frontend discipline, Accessibility floor (focus moves predictably after an action that changes what is on screen): after dismissal, `document.activeElement` is the Pods chrome container (`data-testid` `PODS_CHROME_TEST_ID`, `src/renderer/src/pods/PodsChrome.tsx:17`), the destination of last resort that `PodsChrome.tsx:45-49` already names.
